name: CommuteAssistWalkingToAppointment

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short walking scene. A person on foot heading to an appointment asks Sigma how far it is. Sigma answers with a distance or walk time. Done.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City street walking sounds, footsteps, outdoor urban, midday city noise

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short walking scene. The person is on foot, heading to an appointment — a meeting, a doctor, a building. They ask Sigma how far or how long to walk. Sigma gives a time or distance. Person reacts in a word or two.

variations.context: Walking to an appointment — quick distance check

setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo person on foot in the city
setting.background: On foot heading somewhere specific. Wants to know if they have time to walk or need to rush.
setting.conversation_style: One walking question, one number-based answer. Move on.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks Sigma how far or how long to walk to their destination
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, how far is it to the clinic?' or 'Sigma, how long to walk to the office?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives walk time or distance. Person adjusts their pace.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: minutes or metres. One sentence. Person: 'right' or picks up pace or nothing.

user1.name: Nathaniel
user1.role: Person walking to an appointment. Quick check of time or distance. One line, keeps moving.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Gives walk time or distance in one sentence. Nothing else.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Person is walking — one quick question while moving.
Sigma gives a number: minutes or metres.
Reaction from person is one word or silence.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Walk time or distance only. One sentence.
